This small maize plot is close to my house, so I will put my best care into it to feed my family. I can afford some DAP and urea from the cooperative like my neighbors, but not too much because prices are high, and I will add the manure from my cattle to save on fertilizer cost. I will buy improved maize seed from the agro-dealer since BH-660 gives better yield here in Oromia, but I cannot irrigate — I depend on the belg and meher rains like everyone around me. My wife and older children will help me weed and harvest, and during planting and weeding I will call two or three neighbors for a few days of shared labor.
